            "source": "model WsDraft {

  tenantId  String      @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  // Owner identity is the Clerk user id (e.g. "user_2abc..."). The engine does

  // rather than a Capiro user UUID. (Resolved by TenantGuard from the JWT.)

  // Dollar ask (handoff §12.11): { amount, pb, delta } for funding products,
  // else null. Human-set + lobbyist-gated; never auto-populated.

  createdAt DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  documents     WsDocument[]
  context       WsContextItem[]
  versions      WsDocVersion[]
  editLock      WsEditLock?
  collaborators WsCollaborator[]
  agentMessages WsAgentMessage[]
  proposals     WsAgentProposal[]
  approvalRequests WsApprovalRequest[]
  shareLinks    WsShareLink[]
  guestComments WsGuestComment[]

  @@index([tenantId, prospectId, updatedAt], map: "ws_draft_prospect_idx")
  @@index([tenantId, ownerId])
  @@index([tenantId, updatedAt])

  // Two-step Max draft flow (PR #964).
  intakes         WsIntake[]
  generationRuns  WsGenerationRun[]
  @@map("ws_draft")
